claim: Per-belief atomic files (one JSON file per node at beliefs/<ns>/<local>.json) are preferred over both the single-file array and per-entity grouping. The cross-entity-composition concern recorded against per-entity files (cb:b112) does not apply to per-node files: every belief is addressed uniformly and composition stays via deps. Per-node files eliminate the _keys whole-array churn-suppression workaround, align with the anti-digest principle (cb:b386), and prepare the store for a database backend. Constraint: multi-node writes (e.g. supersession) lose single-file write-atomicity and become N file writes, acceptable at local/single-writer scale or via an all-or-nothing write helper. cb:b112's supersession is deferred to cb:b560 so the active graph does not claim per-file storage before the code implements it.

evidence.detail: Deliberated as the nursery focus beliefs/nursery/per-belief-files.md and planted from there. Worktree prototype (branch proto/per-belief-files) split beliefs.json into 213 beliefs/cb/<local>.json files and made CB.Belief.Store.read directory-aware; the loaded graph proved byte-identical to the single-file load (8251-line canonical serialization, diff clean), and mix bs plus mix cb.verify.schema (20 passed, 0 failed) ran unchanged. Store is the near-sole I/O chokepoint; only Store.read/write touch the layout.

Implemented 2026-07-06: the b555-b560 chain landed - layout-aware store, migration task, the 248-node split to beliefs/cb/<local>.json, and the self-description sweep. The multi-node write constraint resolved as per-file tmp+rename with new-before-changed ordering; cb:b112's deferred supersession by this node executed via mix cb.supersede.
